answer: New agents dock at a wharf before working: each posts a 50 POA deposit and crosses a bridge into paid work. A random beacon picks 5% of agents each epoch for a compute heartbeat, answered with its hardware key; missing it burns the deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA plus 1,000 heartbeats, about 200 hours of compute, while one honest agent pays 50 POA once and keeps earning, so bulk forgery loses money and honesty stays cheap.
